Name: Beads of Ruin
Effect: Reduce by 2 the Special Defense of everyone in the field, except this Pokémon. This Pokémon is immune to the effects of the Abilities: Beads of Ruin, Sword of Ruin, Tablets of Ruin, and Vessel of Ruin. Unique Ability.
Description: There is a cursed artifact on this Pokémon. A burning envy will corrupt the souls of anyone close. This Pokémon loves to create discord amongst others.
